Витамин E.about: Membrane antioxidant: no effect on CVD/cancer in healthy people; for NAFLD - uncertain; tardive dyskinesia - weak conflicting data.
Витамин E.caution: Vitamin E is a fat-soluble antioxidant. 15 Cochrane reviews in the database! For tardive dyskinesia (a side effect of antipsychotics): there is evidence of improvement. For MASLD: there is Cochrane (2 years, 800 IU/day). For Alzheimer's: there is Cochrane, but the effect is clinically small. For CVD/cancer prevention in healthy individuals: NO effect (large RCT). Caution: >400 IU/day increases all-cause mortality in some MAs.
Витамин E.dosage: do not exceed 400 IU, preferably from food
effects: Prevention of CVD and mortality: not confirmed
Витамин E.food_sources: Nuts, vegetable oils, seeds - with a normal diet, deficiency is rare; Healthy people don't need supplements.
Витамин E.guidelines: Cochrane 2018: no clear difference with placebo for tardive dyskinesia; Alzheimer's - no; NAFLD—uncertain. The dose should not exceed 400 IU/day.
Витамин E.how_to_choose: Preferably from food; in supplements no higher than 400 IU. The form (alpha/s-mixed) is not critical - the data does not discriminate.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: Prevention of CVD and mortality: not confirmed

Витамин E.myths: “Antioxidant for everything” – no effect for Alzheimer’s/MCI and CVD. “The more the merrier” - high doses (>400 IU) do not provide benefit; There are no mortality data in key sources.
Витамин E.name: Vitamin E
Витамин E.onset: Delayed effect: for NAFLD courses up to 2 years; clinically small, no immediate flush.
